description: This source file is a Bash script that manages the setup and execution of a rootless OpenClaw service using Podman containers. It includes environment setup, validation, configuration management, token generation, and container orchestration commands to launch or onboard the service.

methods.name: resolve_user_home
methods.description: Resolves the home directory path for a given username.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: validate_single_line_value
methods.description: Ensures a value does not contain control characters.

methods.name: validate_absolute_path
methods.description: Validates that a path is absolute and well-formed.

methods.name: validate_mount_source_path
methods.description: Validates that a mount source path does not contain colon characters.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_regular_file
methods.description: Checks that a file exists, is a safe regular file, and not a symlink.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_dir
methods.description: Checks that a directory exists and is not a symlink.

methods.name: stat_uid
methods.description: Retrieves the UID ownership of a file or directory.

methods.name: stat_mode
methods.description: Retrieves the permission mode of a file or directory.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_dir_owned_by_user
methods.description: Ensures a directory exists, is owned by current user, and has restrictive permissions.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_regular_file_owned_by_user
methods.description: Ensures a file exists, is owned by current user, and has owner-only permissions.

methods.name: ensure_safe_write_file_path
methods.description: Checks that a path is safe for writing a file.

methods.name: write_file_atomically
methods.description: Writes data to a file atomically, ensuring permissions are set correctly.

methods.name: load_podman_env_file
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a specified env file with validation.

methods.name: validate_port
methods.description: Validates a port number is numeric and within valid range.

methods.name: create_token_env_file
methods.description: Creates an env file containing a generate token, ensuring ownership and permissions.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins_via_cli
methods.description: Synchronizes gateway control UI origins via CLI commands.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins
methods.description: Synchronizes gateway control UI origins through a JSON configuration file, updating origins list.

methods.name: upsert_env_var
methods.description: Inserts or updates an environment variable in a file.

methods.name: generate_token_hex_32
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure 32-byte hex token using available system tools.
